title: Look up game information
sourceOrder: Steam is checked first, then Wikidata for missing catalog facts. Critic fallback uses Metacritic, then OpenCritic published by Deku Deals. Optional durations are its attributed HLTB figures. Choose which fields to save.
replaceRefresh: Replace searches the checked groups again even when filled, with a fresh Deku lookup. Provider limits and blocks still apply. Nothing is saved until you review it.
criticPlatformScope: This is the rating published by Deku Deals for its listed edition; the platform may differ from your copy. Review it before replacing a platform-specific rating.
alreadyMatches: Already matches. Confirming this field does not create a false edit.
steamDbNotAutomated: SteamDB does not permit automated scraping. It is skipped without bypassing restrictions; an attributed OpenCritic rating is used when available.
criticUnavailable: No verified critic rating is available from the supported sources. Your saved rating is kept.
criticSourceUnavailable: The critic source is unavailable. Your saved rating is kept; no access restrictions are bypassed.
artworkUnavailable: No verified image is available for this role. The saved URL is kept unchanged.
durationPrivacy: Deku lookup sends the game title, not your playtime or personal notes. It reads public attributed ratings and estimates, without contacting HLTB directly.
durationRounded: The source lists {{source}} h. This field stores whole hours: the proposed {{saved}} h is rounded. Review before saving.
durationEstimate: Published estimate: {{source}} h, not your personal time played.
durationSourceUnavailable: The duration source is unavailable. Existing estimates are unchanged; no blocked requests are bypassed.
chooseDurationIdentity: Choose the matching Deku Deals game or edition to check its data. No similar title is selected automatically.
identity: Choose the correct game or edition
lookupFailed: Information could not be loaded. Your game has not changed.
saveFailed: The save could not be confirmed. Review the current values before trying again.
conflict: The game changed after this lookup. Look it up again and review the current values.
noChanges: No new information is available for these settings.
chooseIdentity: Select the matching game before continuing.
steamUnavailable: Steam could not be checked. Other available facts are shown below.
durationUnavailable: No verified story or completionist estimate was found on Deku Deals. Existing estimates are left unchanged.

batch.title: Autofill information
batch.artworkScope: Only this artwork role for these {{count}} linked games. Existing images are kept until a new candidate loads and its save is confirmed. No player sync.
batch.artworkScope_one: Only this artwork role for the selected linked game. The existing image is kept until a new candidate loads and its save is confirmed. No player sync.
batch.artworkScope_other: Only this artwork role for these {{count}} linked games. Existing images are kept until a new candidate loads and its save is confirmed. No player sync.
batch.autoAfterImport: Try to autofill info after import
batch.afterImportHelp: Accepts all verified catalog proposals for newly added games, filling empty fields. Keeps Steam links, notes and progress.
batch.scope: Only these {{count}} games. No fuzzy edition is chosen automatically; personal progress and Steam links are never changed.
batch.scope_one: Only the selected game. No fuzzy edition is chosen automatically; personal progress and Steam links are never changed.
batch.scope_other: Only these {{count}} games. No fuzzy edition is chosen automatically; personal progress and Steam links are never changed.
batch.waiting: Source limit reached. Waiting briefly before checking again; you can stop without losing added games.
batch.partialResult: Some information saved; a source could not be checked
batch.partial: {{done}} of {{total}} finished. Review the remaining results; already added games are kept.
batch.retryHelp: Retries only information lookup, never game creation or Steam import.
batch.startFailed: Autofill could not start. The current game selection is kept.

jobs.starting: Submitting the batch to the server…
jobs.backgroundHelp: Runs on the server even after you close this page. You can keep using the app.
jobs.connectionHint: The latest status could not be loaded. An already accepted batch keeps running on the server.
jobs.finishedHelp: Results are retained. Check saved fields and resolve any remaining choices.
jobs.cancellingHelp: Stops without undoing saved changes; a write that has already started may finish.
jobs.dismiss: Hide the notice; keep results in history
jobs.noJobs: No batches yet. Select games in Library or enable autofill after importing.
jobs.reviewLoadFailed: This game could not be opened. Results and other pending choices are still available.
jobs.waitingHelp: The source requested a pause. The batch respects that deadline and will resume pending lookups automatically.
jobs.bestMatch: Uses an exact match or one unique match differing only in punctuation, spacing or trademarks. Never guesses a sequel or another edition.
jobs.bestMatchWithCritic: Replace accepts the attributed rating for the matching Deku edition when Steam has none; its platform may differ. Different sequels or editions are not substituted.
jobs.acceptCriticsHelp: Accept all ratings whose only remaining question is Deku’s listed platform, instead of reviewing each game separately.
jobs.acceptCriticsConfirm: Only pending metadata for these games will be looked up again. Their attributed Metacritic rating published on Deku will be accepted, which may belong to another platform. Ambiguous matches and games you have edited still require a choice.
jobs.otherNotice: Additional information is pending; check this game’s options.

items.partial: Fields saved; another source is pending

notices.gameChanged: You edited this game after the batch started. Those changes were not overwritten; review the current values.
notices.gameUnavailable: The game is no longer available to this account.
notices.criticListedPlatformAccepted: Rating saved with its real provider; Deku’s listed platform may differ.
notices.lookupFailed: The source lookup could not be confirmed.
notices.saveFailed: The save was not confirmed. An uncertain write is never repeated automatically.

errors.status: Progress could not be loaded. This does not cancel server work.
errors.start: This submission could not be confirmed. Check its status or explicitly retry with the same identifier, without duplicating it.
errors.action: The operation could not be confirmed. Status will be checked again; a save is not repeated automatically.
errors.unsupported: This API does not support persistent batches yet. Update it to continue in background; no browser-owned batch was started.
